concerns.text: The idea's Methodology sketch says 'Train a Random Forest classifier and an XGBoost model', but the spec trains only XGBoost (baseline and integrated). The Random Forest arm of the idea is dropped without justification. Either add it as an FR or state explicitly in Assumptions why XGBoost-only was chosen (e.g., RF redundant for the incremental-value comparison), so the spec does not silently under-reach the source idea.
